name: Thai Green Pork Curry with Zucchini, Rice, Cashews, Basil & Cilantro (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ small bunch cilantro
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ lime
3 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.

While the rice is cooking, place broth, coconut milk, curry paste, sugar, and salt in a small saucepan. Whisk to combine, then bring to a simmer over medium heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened slightly, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk
1 ½ tbsp Thai curry paste, green
2 tsp brown sugar
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lime into the pan, then add soy sauce and stir to combine. Remove from heat, cover to keep warm, and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place on a plate, then season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pork chops, boneless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through, 3-4 minutes. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Add zucchini, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the zucchini is cooking, roughly chop cashews. Place in a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems, then pick basil leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the bowl with the cashews.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide a ½-cup rice, ½-cup pork, and ½-cup zucchini between plates. Drizzle rice with soy sauce (optional).

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide remaining rice, pork, and zucchini between bowls. Top with curry sauce, herbs, and cashews. Enjoy!
